items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish public/commercial redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; fleet compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Incomplete telemetry does not independently block ordinary growth. complicated.work must remain parked pending remediation of failed banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks. deadlymaracas.com must remain parked pending DNS reachability and compliance evidence. Human counsel is required for upstream data rights, jurisdictional privacy and consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks are searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Progress is limited to partial official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not close tasks without attached evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Retain containment-only execution. Do not create new production, telemetry, spend, deployment, requeue, experiment, or monetization proposals this cycle. Preserve the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed and do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, causal lift, or readiness. Continue existing legal, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, failure-repair, and site-disposition work using recorded evidence only.
